description: This file defines Express route handlers for content-related endpoints including fetching a video feed, listing modules, and fetching details of specific modules and videos. It imports controller functions for handling each route and sets up Swagger API documentation annotations.

methods.name: getFeed
methods.description: Handles requests to retrieve a TikTok-style video feed with cursor pagination.

methods.name: listModules
methods.description: Handles requests to list available content modules.

methods.name: getModuleById
methods.description: Handles requests to retrieve details of a specific content module by its ID.

methods.name: getVideoById
methods.description: Handles requests to retrieve details of a specific video by its ID.
